ratios.quote: Under the terms of the Credit Agreement, the Company is required to maintain a total net leverage ratio (as defined in the Credit Agreement) not to exceed 6.00 :1.00, measured as of the last day of each fiscal quarter. The total net leverage ratio of the Company did not exceed this threshold as of June 30, 2026.

parsed.notes: Actual total net leverage ratio not disclosed; the filing only states compliance as of June 30, 2026. Secured net leverage ratio references set interest rate margins and facility fees only and are excluded.
